description: Header file defining AccessControlList class for managing access control policies, including nested classes for JSON serialization, filtering, and role management.

classes.name: AccessControlList
classes.description: Manages access control policies with nested classes for JSON serialization, filtering, and role management.

classes.name: AccessControlList::JSONACL
classes.description: Represents the JSON structure for access control list configuration.

classes.name: AccessControlList::JSONACL::Plugins
classes.description: Stores plugin rules and default settings.

classes.name: AccessControlList::JSONACL::Group
classes.description: Represents a URL and role pair in the ACL.

classes.name: AccessControlList::Filter
classes.description: Filters access based on URL, callsign, and method, with nested Plugin class for method matching.

classes.name: AccessControlList::Filter::Plugin
classes.description: Checks if a method is allowed based on regex matching.

methods.name: ReplaceString
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring within a string.

methods.name: CreateRegex
methods.description: Creates a regex pattern from a string with wildcards.

methods.name: CreateUrlRegex
methods.description: Creates a regex pattern for URLs with special character handling.

methods.name: GetUrlOrigin
methods.description: Extracts the origin part of a URL according to RFC 3986.
